name: Raven-Code
description: A powerful coding agent that can write, run and debug code on this host, then report what it did. Use it for a fix, a small feature, a script, or a failing test. IMPORTANT: it edits your files for real; before its first modification it may ask the user to authorize a git worktree when the checkout is dirty or already being edited by another Raven-Code instance.
owns: owns coding: writing, running or debugging code. Do not write the code yourself.
